page.overview:
What is Black Infantry?

Black Infantry was a Nilfgaardian Army formation.

On August 1267, squad of Black Infantry managed to sneak across the Yaruga on a bridge constructed from boats where they were least expected and took the fortress at Dillingen during the Second Northern War.
